claims.statement: Learn association-graph sequential backend with conflict-removal revocation and cardinality-affinity regularization plus optional known inlier count.
D3QN with prioritized replay; regularization approximate, printed Eq7 b sign conflicts with definition; partial feasibility not global optimality.
AR/IC distinctions, supervised visual front-end and imitation variant, category training split, nonuniversal F1/gap improvements and slower75.53s inference explicit.
Native graph correspondence/QAP instances trained per visual/QAP class with crossclass tests, no demonstrated unchanged weights across identified native unrelated optimization tasks.
Affinity/F1 mismatch, fixed supervised front-end and costly revocation are explicit limits; empirical score correlation not universal semantic guarantee.
